description: Default actuarial assumptions for Gross Premium Valuation of large group health plans

medical_trend.description: Annual medical cost trend rate applied to the medical portion of expected claims
medical_trend.source: SOA Group Health Trend Survey and CMS National Health Expenditure data
medical_trend.rationale: 8% reflects recent elevated utilization post-COVID normalization and unit cost increases

rx_trend.description: Annual pharmacy (Rx) cost trend rate applied to the Rx portion of expected claims
rx_trend.source: PBM industry trend reports, GLP-1 medication cost impact
rx_trend.rationale: 12% reflects specialty drug pipeline, GLP-1 adoption, and biosimilar lag

claims_adjustment.description: Incremental claims adjustment for IBNR run-out, large claimant pooling charges, and administrative load
claims_adjustment.rationale: 2% adjustment captures IBNR development and stop-loss pooling charges not reflected in base expected claims

cash_card_claims.description: Monthly per-member deduction for health savings card / cash benefit program offset against claims
cash_card_claims.rationale: Cash card benefits reduce net claim liability; applied as a fixed PMPM deduction

claims_split.description: Allocation of total expected claims between medical and pharmacy
claims_split.source: Historical plan experience, adjusted for plan design
claims_split.rationale: Typical large group split; adjust per client experience data when available

discount_rate.description: Annual discount rate used to present-value future cash flows
discount_rate.rationale: Reflects risk-free rate appropriate for near-term insurance liabilities

projection_basis.description: Claims are projected monthly; trends compound continuously to the midpoint of each projection period
